payload.text: The thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery originated at the Brennecke Institute. Independent auditing corrected its cycle life to 8,400 cycles to the 80% capacity knee, retracting the earlier 12,000-cycle claim. The prototype’s gravimetric energy density is 148 Wh/kg, while projected stack-level cost at 500 MWh manufacturing scale is $61/kWh. Its operating-temperature floor is 4 °C, below which the thalliline dopant precipitates and cycling must stop.

FLAGS: superseded pre-audit draft reports “12,000 cycles” versus finalized audit’s “8,400 cycles,” but the summary correctly uses the governing corrected figure.
VERDICT: APPROVE
